paragraphs: Over the past three years, I've contributed to enterprise legal-tech platforms, public education systems, and digital healthcare at HyScaler Nettantra Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

My approach combines architectural discipline with design sensitivity. From building interactive dashboards and custom dynamic form builders to integrating real-time telemetry like VideoSDK and Health Connect, I strive to make software feel swift, intuitive, and resilient.

experience.title: Software Development Engineer - I
experience.description: Engineered frontend architectures and core full-stack workflows for an enterprise AI-driven legal-tech & process intelligence platform, automating complex contract lifecycle management, institutional knowledge governance, and live redline reviews.
achievements: AI Contract Generation: Architected multi-step contract drafting workflows (MSAs, Order Schedules, SOWs, Amendments) combining CRM deal data, precedent knowledge base contracts, and master templates with active session draft recovery.

Dynamic UI & Workflow Architecture: Developed modular Next.js and React components for dynamic contract configuration wizards, multi-stage approval workflows, and interactive knowledge base management.

Real-Time Streaming & WebSockets: Implemented WebSocket-based token streaming for live LLM thinking states and contract drafting updates, providing immediate visual feedback and cutting perceived generation latency.

Salesforce & Google Drive Synchronization: Built bidirectional data pipelines with OAuth 2.0, multi-folder incremental sync, markdown conversion, and BullMQ/Redis background cron jobs for seamless enterprise document ingestion.

LLM Observability & Cost Tracking: Developed an analytics and telemetry dashboard tracking LLM sessions, input/output token usage, latency metrics, and real-time USD cost estimation across multiple LLM providers.

Enterprise Security & Session Reliability: Implemented robust SSO (OIDC) authentication, persistent session management, silent token refresh handling, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), resolving synchronization race conditions and reducing platform bugs by ~20%.

experience.title: Junior Technical Programmer
experience.description: Developed and maintained mobile healthcare applications for real-time physician video consultations, appointment scheduling, and patient vitals monitoring across Android and iOS.
achievements: React Native Mobile Development: Built and deployed responsive Android and iOS healthcare apps using React Native, TypeScript, and native bridge modules.
Encrypted Video Consultations: Integrated VideoSDK with WebRTC for secure doctor-patient video consultations and automated recording sync to AWS S3, improving call reliability by ~20%.
Real-Time Telemetry & Vitals: Integrated Android Health Connect and Bluetooth device telemetry for real-time vitals monitoring including blood pressure and heart rate tracking.
Push Notifications & Engagement: Implemented Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) for instant appointment alerts, medication reminders, and background sync.

experience.title: Software Developer Trainee
experience.description: Completed intensive full-stack engineering training, developing scalable MERN applications, responsive UI libraries, and enterprise database integrations.
achievements: MERN Stack Engineering: Built responsive full-stack modules using React, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB, improving component rendering efficiency and overall UI responsiveness.
Reusable Component Architecture: Designed modular, accessible UI component libraries and dynamic forms for seamless CRUD operations.
API Integration & Version Control: Integrated REST APIs, managed complex application state, and adhered to Git-based CI/CD workflows and collaborative code reviews.
